title: Subscriptions
graph_lead: Where each source comes from, how it's read and where it goes. Pick one to see its whole path.
graph_idle: Can't read now (signed out, failing, needs a change)
graph_hint: Faint lines are sources that can't read now: pick one to see why and how to fix it.
graph_hint_picked: Pick it again or press Esc to unpick. An orange ring marks a source that may bring the same things. Pick an extension or a destination to see every source connected to it.
graph_duplicate: May bring the same things as “{name}”. If they do, turn one of them off.
graph_empty: Nothing brings things into the Inbox or the knowledge base yet.
